race.comment: UNWAVERING (10) makes her debut from the Grahame Begg stable who has a good reputation with fillies. She has won 2 of her 3 jump-outs and is in the right race to make an immediate impact. BETTER BY FAR (1) has finished runner-up in all of her 3 starts in Sydney and has since joined the Melbourne arm of the Waterhouse/Bott stable, who had her winning a jump-out earlier in the month. She has a great chance to go one better in this company. EXPLOSIVE MAGIC (4) will be suited by the number of scratchings to reduce the field size, and with a soft run expected from the pole position, she should be right in the finish again. DIAMONDS FOR HER (3) missed the kick on debut, and just battled home late. She did everything right when winning at a recent jump-out, and she is expected to be a lot more competitive in this. CHAPEL BELLE (13) was fair when finishing fourth at Pakenham-synthetic last time out, and she has top 4 claims in this.
